request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the blue hide: the light sky blue becomes a clear mid slate blue, colour #4a78b8 on the lit side with #2c4470 shadows, not grey and not pale, and dark navy #1a2748 only along the top of the back and tail. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest, the cream belly, throat and claws, the eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
